rows: Copies of all communications (including emails) concerning the "Pre-Eurovision Israel-Calling" event held in Israel in the years 2016, 2017 and 2018.
Granted in part. Sections: 15(1)(a), 35(1), 37(1)(a). Statutory Instrument SI 115 of 2000. *FOI response issued on 12 July 2018.
Audience listening figures for all programmes related to the Pope’s visit. Audience viewing figures for all programmes related to Pope’s visit (in the period of the visit).
Refused on administrative grounds. Section: 15(1)(b) as a result of Section 12(1)(b).

Details regarding costs to RTÉ during its broadcast of the papal visit, containing a specific breakdown of: itemised list of the cost of sending reporters and technical crew to events in Dublin and Knock, including expenses. An itemised list of costs for any presenters, guests, or crew who appeared/worked at 'studio' sites to cover events for the papal visit, including expenses. The cost of hiring any companies to construct off-site studios or other such areas where outside broadcasts were made. The cost of hiring any equipment, vehicles, or other rented items used for broadcasts covering the papal visit.

A list of the costs associated with Hope Solo being hired as a pundit during the World Cup 2018; include a detailed breakdown of individual costs, if any, for Ms Solo's travel, food, accommodation, etc.

I am requesting records (if they exist) of payments/ payments in kind from Piaggio (the manufacturer of Vespa) or any of its agents or subsidiaries in Ireland to Ryan Tubridy over the course of 2018. I am making this request in response to photographs and an article that appeared in a September edition of the RTÉ Guide featuring Ryan Tubridy on a Vespa. Further to this I am seeking records (if they exist) of payments/payments in kind from Piaggio (manufacturer of Vespa) or any of its agents or subsidiaries in Ireland to the RTÉ Guide, arising from the same article.
Refused on administrative grounds. Section 15(1)(a) - no records exist.
Complaints received by RTÉ since the beginning of August 2018, related to its coverage of the visit of Pope Francis to Ireland.
Copies of all records created relating to a recent letter sent by TV3 to RTÉ complaining about the absence of TV3 stars from RTÉ.

Copies of all correspondence between RTÉ and the Tyrone County Board and/or representatives of the Tyrone Senior Football Team relating to their decision not to co-operate with RTÉ for the recent All-Ireland Football Final.
Audio and video archive reported by RTE on 17 Feb 1993 and 19 Feb 1993 re the convictions and fines imposed on TSB Bank.

1. What increases in benefits have been offered to pensioner members of the RTÉ Superannuation Scheme in the last ten years? 2. Have any increases or benefits been offered in that time to any scheme members under the terms of provisions other than Regulation 85? (Regulation 85 concerns authorisation by the Minister for Finance) 3. If so, in how many cases? What percentage increases applied? 4. What percentage of scheme members have received no increase in pension since 2008? 5. Have benefits - or a pension standstill - been universally applied to all members of the scheme in the last 10 years, without exception? 6. Where, and if, there was an imparity of treatment, what law or regulation or resolution of the trustees permitted this? (I.e. does Regulation 85 totally determine all increases in benefits under the scheme? If not, under what terms have any increases been applied to individual pensions since 2008?).
Outside the remit of Freedom of Information. Statutory Instrument SI 115 of 2000.
Provide a copy of the most up to date RTÉ staff manual/handbook (document provided to staff detailing: Sick leave, Annual leave, Pay Grades, Staff Allowances, Expenses policy).

Provide the following: 1. Policy for reporters on foreign assignment (document that sets out what RTÉ will cover for journalists posted outside of Ireland to include: Travel expenses, Accommodation payments, Education for children, Medical Expenses). 2. Provide a list of positions covered by this policy e.g. Washington Correspondent, London Correspondent, Foreign Editor, and Northern Editor.

Provide a copy of the Public Tender or published notice/advertisement for the painting of ‘The Late Late Toy Show’ advertisement mural at the Poolbeg Lighthouse Wall; the project requirements, decision criteria for the awarding of the contract, and the basis on which the final tender award was made (e.g. most economically advantageous tender (MEAT)).
Copy of a Report by the European Broadcast Union (in May 2017) of a ‘Peer to Peer’ review of RTÉ.

Copies of formal written complaints in 2018 for the following programmes: ‘The Late Late Show’, ‘The Tommy Tiernan Show’, ‘Claire Byrne Live’, ‘The Six One News’, ‘The Ray D'Arcy Show’, ‘The Young Offenders’ and ‘First Dates Ireland’.
Granted in part - Summary of Complaints.

Salary arrangements for RTÉ employees based in jurisdictions outside of Republic of Ireland? i.e. employee on RTÉ contract but based in Belfast (within jurisdiction of the United Kingdom). What currency is salary paid in and how is this figure determined? What arrangements are in place to compensate for exchange rate variations? What arrangements are in place to ensure arrangements are equal to colleagues based in ROI? Where is the employee liable for tax and what other allowances would an employee be eligible for, e.g. housing allowance, clothing allowance etc.

The costs surrounding ‘Storm Ophelia’ (October 16- 17, 2017), ‘Storm Emma’ and the ‘Beast from the East’ (end February-March) to RTÉ staff - costs for taxis and hotels and number of staff who had to avail of taxis and hotels for each of these storms.
Refused on administrative grounds. Sections: 15(1)(a) and (c).
Request for cost to RTÉ of hosting 'The Late Late Show in London' i.e. provide details of some costs such as travel/hotels,
Records of the cost to RTÉ of the new 'Fair City’ set - both construction costs and labour costs. What was the total cost to RTÉ or the taxpayer for building it.

The costs to RTÉ of constructing the new ‘Fair City’ set: breakdown of payments made to named third parties concerning the construction of the set and what service/materials the third parties provided. The time period of construction and the numbers involved in the construction project.
